description: The National Wetlands Inventory maps wetland type and extent across the United States, and the Wetlands Mapper displays those data online. The Fish and Wildlife Service states that the mapped wetlands use a biological definition of wetlands and do not define the limits of any government's jurisdiction or the scope of regulatory programmes, so users planning work that could affect wetlands are referred to their local US Army Corps of Engineers regulatory office. The page links documentation, frequently asked questions, a disclaimer, data limitations and a geodatabase user caution for the wetlands geodatabase. Access is free and public; no licence is stated beyond US government data. Caveats: mapping dates and methods vary by area, so currency and accuracy differ across the country. The inventory provides national coverage of wetlands and riparian habitat for green-blue infrastructure mapping, flood storage and coastal buffer analysis, and for screening infrastructure corridors for wetland impacts; a related record is the Transboundary Wetlands Database.
